recommendation: Keep the source fix. It completes the original FHIR-16822 intent in the current R6 source while preserving concrete Patient examples and CQL snippets where Patient is intentionally the example subject.
issue_request: FHIR-16822 was Published/Persuasive for the STU3 Measure section and requested review of Measure documentation that referred to patient-based measures where the broader Measure subject model should be used.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied by b06ccf7d682d1e5bb2489464b8d16998b57ebe1c, matching Jira's SVN 14855 comment, which changed the then-current Quality Reporting topic from patient/patient-list wording to subject/individual wording.
additional_context: Current Measure and MeasureReport are active CQI resources, the Quality Reporting page is in the current source hierarchy, and Measure operation definitions are listed as Measure operations. Later Measure-family work added group-level subjects, Group-specified/reporting support, and current scoring guidance, leaving several active comments, operation parameter descriptions, example descriptions, and scoring paragraphs with patient-level or Patient-based wording even though explicit Patient examples remain valid.
reconciliation: Changed active source so generic scoring formulas use cases, Measure and MeasureReport Group comments use subject-based measures, supplemental and criteria comments use subjects or events, operation lastReceivedOn text uses individual-level reports and subjects, and MeasureReport examples use subject-list or summary-level wording matching the actual report type. Also corrected the coupled ratio sentence label from performance rate to performance ratio.
source_changes: source/clinicalreasoning-quality-reporting.html: changed generic performance-rate and performance-ratio paragraphs from patients to cases and fixed the ratio sentence label.

source/measure/structuredefinition-Measure.xml: changed Measure population, groupDefinition, stratifier groupDefinition, and supplementalData comments from patient-only examples to subject, subject/event, or subject-based wording.
source/measurereport/structuredefinition-MeasureReport.xml: changed Group population comments from Patient-based to subject-based measure examples.

source/measure/operationdefinition-Measure-evaluate.xml and source/measure/operationdefinition-Measure-evaluate-measure.xml: changed lastReceivedOn documentation from patient-level/patient wording to individual-level/subject wording.

source/measurereport/list-MeasureReport-examples.xml and source/measurereport/measurereport-countquantity-example.xml: changed a summary MeasureReport example description from patient-level to summary-level.

source/measurereport/measurereport-cms146-cat2-example.xml: changed generated narrative type text to subject-list and a comment from patient-level to individual-level, matching the actual subject-list report structure.
